messages:
maya_sales: ACME wants a Go sample for POC: streaming responses (SSE), function/tool calls (search + enrichment), strict JSON output for their UI, and short answers on BYOK/KMS + SSO. Also need a ballpark for burst capacity (7k concurrent, ~40s, ~180 output tokens). Can someone drop a minimal Go handshake + streaming pattern and quick pricing?

leo_devex: Minimal Go pattern (backend proxy + SSE):
```go
// POST /handshake -> get ephemeral token
// HTTP GET /proxy/stream -> proxy to Redwood SSE with Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
// read bufio.NewReader(resp.Body).ReadString('\n') and parse NDJSON chunks
```
Use SDK helper `client.Stream(...).OnToolCall` to intercept tool requests.

nina_soleng: Tool-call flow: model emits {type:tool_call, tool:search, args:{q:"..."}} as a chunk. Backend should call internal search, then POST result to /v1/streams/{stream_id}/tool_result or write the result back on the websocket. For SSE proxy include stream_id in handshake payload.

tom_infra: Handshake note: never put long-lived keys in browser. Pattern: browser -> your backend -> call Redwood /handshake (allowed_origin) -> return ephemeral token to browser or stream via backend proxy. Ephemeral token TTL 30-60s. For Private/Dedicated we support IP allowlist and VPC-only control plane.

aditi_sec: Short compliance answers: SOC2 available under NDA; hosted default keys are cloud-managed, Dedicated/Private support BYOK/HSM; audit logs and retention configurable on enterprise contracts. I'll provide a one-page Q&A.

rachel_pricing: Ballpark (hosted): 180 output tokens * $0.00036 = $0.0648/session. 7k concurrent * $0.0648 = ~$454/minute peak (sessions ~40s -> ~$303/minute after time adjustment). Add 15% buffer -> ~$349/min. Dedicated gives lower per-token with commit; I can model 3 scenarios and send a spreadsheet.

deploy-bot: Deploy: presales/go-sse-proxy -> commit c7d8e9 (staging).

maya_sales: Thanks all. Deliverables: Leo -> Go repo + runbook; Nina -> tool-call example; Aditi -> Q&A doc; Rachel -> pricing spreadsheet. Can we demo Thu 11am PT?

leo_devex: Thu 11am PT works.
